trial_court: Court of III Additional District Judge, Narsinghpur, RCSHM No. 41/2022
case_name: Smt. Ambika Sahu vs Virendra Sahu
acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: The applicant/wife seeks transfer of a case filed by her husband under Section 9 of Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 from the Court of III Additional District Judge, Narsinghpur to the Court of Additional District Judge, Bareli.

legal_principles.principle: The principle of prior in time prevails.
legal_principles.held: Undisputedly the respondent/husband has filed an application under Section 9 for Restitution of Conjugal Rights on 28.03.2022. Therefore, the respondent/husband filed an application under Section 9 of Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 prior to filing of the cases under Section 12 of Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 as well as Section 125 of Cr.P.C by the respondent/wife.
cited_cases: Balvir Singh Gurjar @ Rinku vs. Nitu, (2015) 4 MPLJ 184

legal_principles.principle: The court may transfer a case to another court if it is conducive and proper.
legal_principles.held: Therefore, it would be conducive and proper to transfer the case filed under Section 9 of Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 by the respondent/husband to the Court of Bareli, District-Raisen.

outcome.final_order: The case was transferred to the Court of Additional District Judge, Bareli.
